use: Representative destination points for straight-line distance context only. These are not routing results, district centroids, confirmed vehicle entrances or individual employer locations. Let the candidate choose a workplace address before generating any actual commute estimate.

geocoder.name: City of Houston COH Verified Address Locator
geocoder.note: Each city-geocoded address returned score 100. This is the service's address-match score, not independently verified positional accuracy. Use each anchor's geocoder_query as SingleLine. Numeric precision must not be represented as measured accuracy.

destinations.label: Ion / Midtown
destinations.note: One building represents the broad Ion/Midtown hub. The operator separately recommends 4111 Fannin Street for the parking garage; this point is not that garage entrance.

destinations.label: Downtown
destinations.note: The publicly listed district-office address is a representative downtown point, not the candidate's employer or the geographic center of all downtown workplaces.

destinations.label: Energy Corridor
destinations.note: The publicly listed district-office address represents the broad Energy Corridor area. Actual employer locations throughout the corridor differ.

destinations.label: Texas Medical Center
destinations.anchor_name: Texas Medical Center medical-campus executive offices
destinations.note: Represents the medical campus using its listed executive-office address. It does not represent Helix Park, a particular hospital entrance or parking destination.

destinations.label: NASA / Clear Lake
destinations.note: Represents the Johnson Space Center address, not every Clear Lake workplace or an access-controlled gate. It must not be used to promise a drive time or public campus access.

destinations.label: George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH)
destinations.note: The airport operator recommends this navigation address. It is a representative terminal-area address, not an individual terminal's drop-off curb or runway center. Terminal choice changes actual travel.

destinations.label: William P. Hobby Airport (HOU)
destinations.note: Converted the operator's degrees-and-decimal-minutes GPS to decimal degrees. This is the operator's general navigation point, not a separately verified drop-off curb. The City address geocoder returned a different point about 255 meters north; the operator-published GPS is used here explicitly.
